### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. Camurati-Engelmann disease type 2  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.452)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-2173789, Reactome:R-HSA-2129379)

**Proposed mechanism:** LTBP4 (HGNC:6732) —DISRUPTS→ TGF-beta signaling pathway (P01138); TGFB2 (HGNC:11720) —DISRUPTS→ TGF-beta signaling pathway (P01138); TGF-beta signaling pathway (P01138) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal connective tissue development (HP:0003198); TGF-beta signaling pathway (P01138) —LEADS_TO→ Hyperphosphatemia (HP:0003174). Loss-of-function mutations in LTBP4 (associated with MONDO:0013170) and TGFB2 (associated with Camurati-Engelmann disease type 2) disrupt the TGF-beta signaling pathway, leading to downstream phenotypic consequences including abnormal connective tissue development and hyperphosphatemia.

**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that the causal variants for MONDO:0013170 and Camurati-Engelmann disease type 2 (MONDO:0011690) affect entirely distinct cellular pathways that do not converge on TGF-beta signaling or extracellular matrix organization. _(variant: rs12345678)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanism involving TGF-beta signaling could reveal potential therapeutic targets for both diseases, such as modulators of TGF-beta pathway activity or agents that promote extracellular matrix repair.
